_about: D-09 file assets + storage metadata + S3 copy behaviour. Ported from 01a93e17216faea7bfc156b0f864cbbe420d1c52
_method: Values produced by executing the named Python code under pi_dash.settings.test with no DB/S3 (venv /tmp/ct100-django-venv). Generators: /tmp/fx_d09b.py, /tmp/fx_d09c.py (throwaway).

update_sql: UPDATE "file_assets" SET "deleted_at" = '2026-09-28 06:00:00+00:00' WHERE ("file_assets"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "file_assets"."created_at" < '2026-09-21 06:00:00+00:00' AND NOT "file_assets"."is_uploaded")
delete_unuploaded_file_asset.trap: .delete() on the default manager routes to SoftDeletionQuerySet.delete -> UPDATE file_assets SET deleted_at=now (db/mixins.py:49-53), scoped to deleted_at IS NULL. This sweep NEVER hard-deletes. Predicate: created_at < cutoff AND is_uploaded IS FALSE.

get_asset_object_metadata: FileAsset.objects.get(pk) (DoesNotExist -> silent); S3Storage().get_object_metadata(asset.asset.name) -> asset.storage_metadata; save(update_fields=['storage_metadata']); broad except -> log_exception. Returns None.
entity_id_note: DRAFT_ISSUE_ATTACHMENT exists on the enum but is ABSENT from the mapping -> {} (port as-is); unknown types -> {}.

extract_asset_ids.note: BeautifulSoup(html, 'html.parser'); [tag.get('src') for tags if tag.get('src')]; ANY exception (incl. None input: TypeError) -> log_exception + []. Tag name passed by callers is 'image-component'.

replace_asset_ids.note: Rewrites src where src == old_asset_id; returns str(soup) (re-serialized HTML); exception -> return ORIGINAL html.

update_description: updated=replace_asset_ids(entity.description_html, tag, duplicated_assets); entity.description_html=updated; entity.save() FULL save; returns updated html.

sync_with_external_service.contract: convert_document(html, variant='rich' iff entity_name=='PAGE' else 'document'); LiveConversionError -> log_exception + {} so the duplicate is still created (empty binary regenerated on first open).

copy_assets.destination_key: {workspace.id}/{uuid4hex}-{original.attributes['name']} (KeyError if name missing — unguarded .get on attributes dict itself would be None-attr crash; port as-is).
copy_assets.duplicate_row: attributes={name,type,size} subset; asset=destination_key; size copied; workspace; created_by=user_id; entity_type copied; project_id; storage_metadata copied; **get_entity_id_field(entity_type, entity_identifier). storage.copy_object(src_key, dst_key) per asset.

copy_s3_objects_of_description_and_asset.entity_map: {PAGE: Page, ISSUE: Issue}; anything else -> ValueError -> caught -> log_exception -> return [] (list, NOT None).
copy_s3_objects_of_description_and_asset.flow: get entity (DoesNotExist -> [] via broad except); extract ids (tag 'image-component'); copy_assets; update_description; sync_with_external_service(updated_html); iff external_data non-empty: description_json = data.get(...) or {} (NOT NULL + default=dict trap: never store None); binary b64decoded iff present; entity.save(). Success path returns None (bare return); failure returns [].

delete_unuploaded_file_asset.before: file_assets rows is_uploaded=false, created_at < now()-7d, deleted_at NULL.
delete_unuploaded_file_asset.after: Same rows with deleted_at = run timestamp; all other rows untouched.

copy_s3_objects.before: Source entity with description_html referencing asset ids; source FileAsset rows uploaded.
copy_s3_objects.after: New FileAsset rows (is_uploaded=true) + new S3 keys; entity description_html rewritten to new ids; description_json/binary refreshed iff the live service answered.
